answer: Use rotating service bonds with independent review lanes. 1) Each newcomer locks 36 POA for 30 days and commits a signed task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four hidden-nonce tasks; three established peers from unrelated funding clusters reproduce random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized withdrawals merge keys into one seat, and a fraud proof burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats freezes 36,000 POA, risks 18,000, and requires 4,000 tasks plus 12,000 reviews. Like saffron in an orchard, each anchor marks a single root among many labels.
